description: Simulate paying off a list of debts under both the snowball strategy (smallest balance first) and the avalanche strategy (highest interest rate first), given a fixed extra monthly payment stacked on top of everyone's minimum payment, and compare months to payoff and total interest between the two.

minPayment.description: Minimum monthly payment required on this debt

ratePercent.description: Annual interest rate for this debt, as a percent

extraMonthlyPayment.description: Extra amount paid each month on top of every debt's minimum payment, default 0

name: plan_debt_payoff
